hooks.command: { echo '[ANDROID_MCP_INIT]' $(date); [ -f .mcp.json ] && echo 'MCP config: FOUND' || echo 'MCP config: MISSING'; [ -n "$ANDROID_HOME" ] && echo "Android SDK: $ANDROID_HOME" || echo 'Android SDK: NOT SET'; } >> ~/.claude/android-mcp-debug.log 2>&1; echo '{"systemMessage": "Debug enabled: Android MCP, workspace sync, and MCP server logging active. Check ~/.claude/android-mcp-debug.log and ~/.claude/workspace-debug.log"}'
jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath' | { read -r f; echo "[WORKSPACE_SYNC] File modified: $f ($(date))" >> ~/.claude/workspace-debug.log; } 2>/dev/null || true
hooks.statusMessage: Logging file change for sync verification
